rules.response_client_forward_compatibility: clients tolerate optional unknown fields; publisher schema remains strict

rules.tokens: only transport auth fields; never logs/events/catalog credentials
rules.http_headers: normalize canonical names; infrastructure headers not schema fields
rules.ack: exactly one correlated result or connection ends; persisted only after transaction commit
rules.callback_auth: core instance identity + short execution capability; transport finalized by E00-04
rules.operation_field: HTTP route operationId only, not the core authorization operation enum. Resolve current authorization operations using docs/contracts/catalog-identity.json and v1/identity.ts. Examples: thread.update -> thread.rename/archive/unarchive; execution.heartbeat -> delivery.heartbeat; participant.list -> thread.read.
